title: 第一卷 第26章 史密斯探长
novel_title: 津门武圣，从苦力开始每日结算
content_zh:
陆川松开手。

    看着魏兴那扭曲的尸体，陆川心里没有半点波澜。

    就像捏死了一只臭虫。

    “下辈子，记得把嘴放干净点。”

    陆川低声说了一句。

    转身，开窗，跃出。

    动作行云流水，一气呵成。

    前后不过一分钟。

    陆川没有走大门。

    他像一只幽灵，在阴影里穿梭。

    路过门房的时候，那两个打手还在抽烟。

    “刚才好像听见屋里有点动静？”

    “听岔了吧，魏爷正办事呢，那动静能小吗？”

    “嘿嘿，也是，魏爷那是老当益壮......”

    两人猥琐地笑了起来。

    陆川路过他们身后，脚步未停。

    杀他们？

    没必要。

    而且，死人是没有恐惧的。

    只有活人，才能把恐惧传出去。

    陆川脚下一点翻出高墙，落在巷子里，深吸了一口深夜的凉气。

    空气里带着煤烟味和河水的腥气，但他觉得格外清新。

    “魏兴死了。”

    “明天巡捕房的人要是来了，发现正主没了，那表情一定很精彩。”

    陆川嘴角勾起一抹冷笑。

    但他没打算回家睡觉。

    今晚的戏，才唱了一半。

    魏兴是漕运商会的狗。

    咬人的狗死了，牵狗的人还在。

    还有那群拿着枪的洋人巡捕。

    既然他们想玩，那就玩把大的。

    “巡捕房。”

    陆川抬头，看向远处租界方向那片灯火通明的区域。

    那里是洋人的地盘，也是津门最森严的地方。

    “听说那个洋人探长叫史密斯？”

    “呵呵......史密斯，说不定你晚上会死。”

    陆川理了理衣领，身形一晃，消失在街道尽头。

    ......

    津门巡捕房，位于英租界中心，一栋红砖砌成的西式小楼。

    门口挂着米字旗，两盏探照灯来回扫射。

    门口站着两个印度阿三巡捕，头戴红布包头，手里提着警棍，正打着哈欠。

    “该死的热天气。”

    “真想喝一杯冰镇啤酒。”

    一个阿三抱怨道。

    “忍忍吧，明天有大行动。”

    另一个阿三压低声音，“听说要去抓个叫陆川的中国犯人，魏老板出了大价钱。”

    “陆川？就是那个打死洋人拳手的？”

    “嘘！小声点，那是个狠角色。”

    两人正聊着。

    突然，一阵风吹过，卷起地上的几片落叶。

    那个背对着大门的阿三突然觉得脖子一凉。

    像是被什么冰冷的东西贴上了。

    他下意识地想回头。

    “咔嚓。”

    一声脆响。

    阿三的后颈被一只手刀切中，连哼都没哼一声，直接瘫软下去。

    另一个阿三刚想喊。

    一只大手捂住了他的嘴，紧接着太阳穴上挨了一记手刀。
content_en:
Lu Chuan let go of his hand.

    Looking at Wei Xing's twisted corpse, Lu Chuan didn't feel the slightest emotion.

    It's like squeezing a bug to death.

    "In the next life, remember to keep your mouth clean."

    Lu Chuan whispered.

    Turn around, open the window, and jump out.

    The movements are smooth and smooth, done in one go.

    It didn't take more than a minute.

    Lu Chuan did not go through the door.

    He was like a ghost, moving through the shadows.

    When passing by the concierge, the two thugs were still smoking.

    "I thought I heard some movement in the house just now?"

    "That's wrong. Mr. Wei is doing something. Can the noise be quiet?"

    "Hehe, that's right, Mr. Wei is so old and strong..."

    The two laughed obscenely.

    Lu Chuan passed behind them without stopping.

    Kill them?

    No need.

    Moreover, the dead have no fear.

    Only living people can spread fear.

    Lu Chuan's feet climbed out of the high wall, landed in the alley, and took a deep breath of the cool night air.

    The air smelled of coal smoke and river water, but he felt particularly fresh.

    "Wei Xing is dead."

    "If the people from the patrol room come tomorrow and find that the real owner is gone, their expressions will be very exciting."

    A sneer curled up at the corner of Lu Chuan's mouth.

    But he had no intention of going home and sleeping.

    Tonight's play is only half done.

    Wei Xing is the dog of the Water Transport Chamber of Commerce.

    The biting dog dies, but the person holding the dog is still there.

    There are also a group of foreigners with guns on patrol.

    Since they want to play, let's play big.

    "Patrol room."

    Lu Chuan raised his head and looked at the brightly lit area in the distance in the direction of the concession.

    It was the territory of foreigners and the most formidable place in Tianjin.

    "I heard that the foreign detective is called Smith?"

    "Haha... Smith, maybe you will die tonight."

    Lu Chuan straightened his collar, swayed and disappeared at the end of the street.

    ...

    The Jinmen Patrol House is located in the center of the British Concession. It is a small Western-style building made of red bricks.

    A Union Jack flag was hung at the door, and two searchlights were shooting back and forth.

    Standing at the door were two Indian police officers, wearing red cloth turbans and holding batons in their hands, yawning.

    "Damn hot weather."

    "I really want a cold beer."

    An Asan complained.

    "Be patient, there will be big action tomorrow."

    The other Ah San lowered his voice, "I heard that we were going to catch a Chinese prisoner named Lu Chuan, and Boss Wei paid a big price."

    "Lu Chuan? Is he the one who killed the foreign boxer?"

    "Shh! Keep your voice down, that's a ruthless character."

    The two were chatting.

    Suddenly, a gust of wind blew through and picked up a few fallen leaves on the ground.

    Ah San, who had his back to the door, suddenly felt a chill on his neck.

    It was as if something cold had been attached to it.

    He subconsciously wanted to look back.

    "Click."

    There was a crisp sound.

    Ah San's back of the neck was cut by a hand knife, and he collapsed without even a groan.

    Another Asan just wanted to shout.

    A big hand covered his mouth, followed by a knife on his temple.
